decision.reason: [ev-782350fea3b9] is just a one-line release-note title, "Drop Env Vars for v1", with a link to PR #6576. It doesn't say which environment variables were dropped or which component (controller, chart) used them. It also doesn't say whether anything replaces them or what happens to an environment that still sets them (ignored, or startup failure). We need the PR #6576 diff or the v1 upgrade/migration guide that lists the removed variables and their replacements before the subject, applicability and consequence can be written.
